name: Sonoda Reika
source:
She teaches mathematics at Kawachi Juku, a preparatory school. She is the younger sister of Sakurako Onami.

In contrast to her older sister, who has a gentle image, she is a cool woman who does not show her emotions, but she has a troublesome personality that sometimes plays with men's feelings with her charming attitude.

[spoiler] She is the real mother of the protagonist. Angry after losing her lover to her sister she got revenge by getting pregnant. She then forced her sister to raise him.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/kanjyuku/index.html]official site[/url]]
